meta.title: About Us | Dentaloria
meta.description: Learn about Dentaloria's mission to connect patients with trusted dental clinics abroad, with transparent pricing and a strong commitment to privacy.

hero.title: About Dentaloria
hero.subtitle: Making it simple to find trusted dental care abroad.

intro: Dentaloria connects patients from around the world with carefully selected dental clinics abroad, making high-quality, affordable dental care simple to find and easy to trust. We believe getting treatment abroad shouldn't mean navigating it alone — so we built a platform where you can compare real clinics, see transparent pricing, and reach out directly, all in your own language.

verifiedClinics.title: Verified Clinics
verifiedClinics.description: Every partner clinic is reviewed before it appears on Dentaloria.

transparentPricing.title: Transparent Pricing
transparentPricing.description: Each clinic lists a starting price range up front, so you can compare before you apply.

multilingual.title: Multilingual Support
multilingual.description: Browse and get in touch in your own language, in 7 languages.

directApplications.title: Direct Applications
directApplications.description: Compare clinics, then send your request in a few clicks. From there, you deal directly with the clinic you chose.

privacy.title: Your Privacy Matters
privacy.description: Any information you share through Dentaloria — including personal and treatment details — is handled with strict confidentiality and used only to connect you with the clinic you choose.

operatedBy: Dentaloria is designed and operated by Digimoria.
